# Gitasks 0.4.0

Gitasks 0.4.0 expands the local issue board into a five-route repository workspace while keeping GitHub Issues canonical and retaining the 0.3 CLI/status protocol.

## Install or upgrade

```bash
npm install --save-dev gitasks@0.4.0
npx gitasks init
npx gitasks ui
```

Initialization creates missing labels and guidance without replacing an existing `.gitasks/protocol.md` or consumer-authored `AGENTS.md` content.

## Highlights

- Overview, Tasks, Activity, Pull Requests, and Milestones routes with direct navigation and responsive sidebar/drawer behavior.
- One shared Tasks dataset for board/list views, filters, sorting, detail, pagination, and accessible Move-to actions.
- Pointer drag handles and touch long-press moves with visible targets, cancellation, rollback, and no requests for invalid/no-op drops.
- Real GitHub activity with stated coverage rather than synthetic timestamps.
- Pull-request details and permission-governed creation, editing, review, reviewer, draft, assignment, milestone, and SHA-guarded merge workflows.
- Milestone creation/editing/state changes and progress that explicitly includes issues and pull requests.
- Honest partial, permission, unsupported, ambiguous-result, pagination, and retry states.
- Clean modular builds, an exact npm allowlist, installed-tarball smoke verification, and read-only non-publishing CI across supported Node generations.

## Security and architecture

Gitasks still binds only to `127.0.0.1`, validates Host and mutation Origin, requires a per-process CSRF token, and applies a restrictive CSP. GitHub credentials remain in `gh`; browser code receives no token. User content renders as text and only validated GitHub/avatar HTTP(S) URLs become actionable. Same-entity mutations are serialized, and non-idempotent operations are not blindly replayed after ambiguous results.

Gitasks has no framework, database, hosted backend, polling, WebSocket, browser credential, or long-lived cache. Repository permissions, rules, API availability, and rate limits continue to govern what can be read or changed.

## From 0.3

Existing `list`, `create`, lifecycle transition, `init`, and `ui` commands remain. The six statuses and Unclassified behavior are unchanged. The former single board becomes the Tasks page within the broader workspace; pull requests, activity, milestones, richer issue data, and guarded mutations are now first-class local workflows.

See [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md), [README.md](../../README.md), and [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the complete release contract.
